name: yf_actions
description:
Corporate actions (dividends and stock splits together) for one ticker from Yahoo Finance (yfinance actions).
Returns: {symbol, data_points (all rows), truncated, actions: the most recent limit rows, oldest first, each {Date, Dividends, Stock Splits} (0 in the column that does not apply)}.
Inputs (* required): symbol* (Yahoo ticker, e.g. AAPL, BRK-B, 7203.T); limit (rows, 1-1000; default 100).
One kind only: yf_dividends or yf_splits.
Example: {"symbol": "AAPL", "limit": 20}
